nodes.data: It’s snapshot time. After last weeks snapshot, which did not include any changes at all, we decided to make this weeks snapshot a little bit more interesting. So we added tons of new features, all of them disguised as bugfixes.

bugList.title: Tab support is not possible with player names when using the ‘/playsound’ command
Placing torches on other torches
Upside down stairs have hitbox of regular stairs / regular stairs have wrong hitbox
Heads Dropped from Charged Creeper Explosion Ignore Gamerules
Tool-tip for regular sandstone slab is incorrect
If you place block on two-block-tall plants,it will destroy them.
Skulls too small in item frames
Using Pick Block on a colored door returns a regular door
Breaking colored doors turns them into regular doors
Old oak doors still called ‘Wooden Door’ instead of ‘Oak Door’
Helmets can’t be taken off of armor stands while flying above them in creative mode
Skull on small Armor Stand are offset
Beds make incorrect sounds
Selecting “Hardcore” prior creating a debug world yields a “hardcore debug world”
Baby Bunnie’s Name Tags
/entitydata tab autocomplete keeps entering player’s name
Fence gates lock closed, and will not open from pressure plate activation.
Summoning a FallingSand entity with {Block:”leaves”} crashes the client
Hopper: java.lang.IllegalArgumentException
Hopper: java.lang.NullPointerException
Hopper: java.lang.ClassCastException
Iron Golems do not target creepers
Crash: /give @p skull 1 3 {SkullOwner:} [SMP]
Hopper: java.util.ConcurrentModificationException
Hopper: java.lang.NullPointerException
Hopper: java.lang.IllegalArgumentException
/execute coordinates don’t work
Only smoothstone should make stone slabs.
